tools.name: contacts_find
tools.title: Find contacts
tools.description: Searches the user's contacts (Nightdrive Contacts: iCloud, Google and CardDAV address books, one person's cards in several accounts as one) and returns each match's id, name, company, title, email addresses and phone numbers. Every word must match a name, nickname, company, title, email address, number or street address; a number matches without its spaces or leading 0 (040 123 finds +358 40 123). count is how many matched, people at most limit of them. Use it to find someone's address or number, then contacts_card with the id for the whole card.

query.title: Search
query.description: Words to look for, e.g. a name, a company or part of a number

tools.name: contacts_card
tools.title: Contact card
tools.description: One person's whole card from the user's contacts: name, company, title, nickname, email addresses, phone numbers, street addresses, web addresses, birthday (YYYY-MM-DD, or --MM-DD without the year), note, and the accounts and card ids it comes from. who is an id from contacts_find, an email address or a phone number. An error says when no one matches.

who.title: Who
who.description: A card's id (from contacts_find), an email address or a phone number
